title: Conversations on Central Banking: Macroeconomy in the Age of Artificial Intelligence
hook_text: The Fed is bringing AI into the room
script:
The Federal Reserve is bringing AI into the room.
Your savings rate might soon be influenced by machine learning models.
Cleveland Fed President Beth Hammack hosts a macroeconomy summit on November seventeenth.
Researchers are tracking how these tools change labor productivity and wages.
Goldman Sachs predicts AI could boost global GDP by seven percent.
That equals an extra zero point five percent in annual growth.
Central bankers must now decide if AI creates faster inflation cycles.
This shift changes how the Fed sets interest rates for everyone.
Do you trust AI to manage the economy?
